tools.name: search_denial_codes
tools.description: Search CARC/RARC denial reason codes with appeal strategies and required evidence. Use when analyzing a claim denial to find the denial code meaning and recommended appeal approach.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'CO-4 procedure not covered', 'medical necessity denial', 'CARC 50')

tools.name: search_appeal_regulations
tools.description: Find payer-specific appeal timelines, filing requirements, and escalation paths. Use when determining appeal deadlines and submission requirements for a specific payer.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'Medicare appeal filing deadline', 'UnitedHealthcare peer-to-peer review', 'ERISA external review')

payer_name.description: Optional: Filter by payer name (e.g., 'Medicare', 'Aetna', 'Blue Cross Blue Shield')

tools.name: search_clinical_guidelines
tools.description: Find medical necessity criteria, clinical practice guidelines, and evidence requirements by procedure. Use when building clinical justification for an appeal.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'MRI lumbar spine medical necessity', 'joint replacement criteria', 'InterQual imaging')
